fact: The party is traveling by boat across the vast, dark subterranean waters of the Darklake.
source_quote: On the Darklake, the party weighed their routes.
subject: Darklake

fact: Blingdenstone is identified as the known possible exit from the Underdark.
source_quote: Blingdenstone was the known exit
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: The Neverlight Grove is the Myconid home where Stool and Rumpadump long to return.
source_quote: The Neverlight Grove is the Myconid home where Stool and Rumpadump longed to return.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: The Lost Tomb of Khaem is said to hold magical treasure and lies on the route between the party and Blingdenstone.
source_quote: the tomb lay on the way; the tomb was four days' travel by boat
subject: Lost Tomb of Khaem

fact: Stool longs to return to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: The Neverlight Grove is the Myconid home where Stool and Rumpadump longed to return.
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump longs to return to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: The Neverlight Grove is the Myconid home where Stool and Rumpadump longed to return.
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Sarith feels a compulsion to go to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Sarith feels a compulsion to go to the Grove.
subject: Sarith

fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a gnome previously rescued by the party from spider webs, who mentioned the Lost Tomb of Khaem.
source_quote: Lost Tomb of Khaem mentioned by Fargas Rumblefoot, the gnome they rescued in the spider webs
subject: Fargas Rumblefoot

fact: Buppido is dead.
source_quote: Buppido is dead.
subject: Buppido

fact: The Myconids have a circle that Zalthir recalls is under demonic influence.
source_quote: Zalthir recalls that the circle is under some demonic influence.
subject: Myconids

fact: A swarm of stirges, resembling oversized bats crossed with mosquitoes, ambushed the party.
source_quote: ambushed by a swarm of stirges that descended from the cavern ceiling above
subject: Stirge

fact: The stirges have AC 14, 2 hit points, and a 1d4+3 piercing bite.
source_quote: with AC 14, 2 hit points each, and a 1d4+3 piercing bite
subject: Stirge

fact: Zalthir incinerates three stirges mid-air with a 15-foot cone of fire.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed a 15-foot cone of searing fire that incinerated three of the creatures mid-air
subject: Zalthir's fire cone

fact: Zalthir punches down a fourth stirge after incinerating the first three.
source_quote: then punched down another
subject: Zalthir's punch

fact: Daz deflects a diving stirge with a shimmering barrier of force.
source_quote: Daz conjured a shimmering barrier of force to deflect one that dove straight at him
subject: Daz's shield

fact: Thorin cuts down two stirges with his longsword.
source_quote: Thorin drew his longsword and cut down two more in rapid succession
subject: Thorin's sword strikes

fact: Gyrgum struggles to pry loose a stirge latched onto him that is draining his blood.
source_quote: Gyrgum struggled to pry one loose that had latched onto him and begun to drain his blood
subject: Gyrgum's struggle

fact: Gyrgum has no blood, so he is unaffected by blood-draining stirges.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump are safe from the stirges because they have no blood.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Stool has no blood, so he is unaffected by blood-draining stirges.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump are safe from the stirges because they have no blood.
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump has no blood, so he is unaffected by blood-draining stirges.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump are safe from the stirges because they have no blood.
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Daz ends the encounter by striking the remaining stirges with unerring magical bolts.
source_quote: Daz finally ended the encounter by firing a volley of unerring magical bolts that struck the last of the creatures
subject: Daz's magical bolts

fact: Jimjar wagers an empty shell gem in a bet regarding the nature of the Myconid circle.
source_quote: Jimjar made a new wager, betting an empty shell gem
subject: shell gem

fact: Thorin uses a longsword to attack stirges during the ambush.
source_quote: Thorin drew his longsword and cut down two more
subject: longsword

fact: Gyrgum attempts to strike a stirge with a hand axe but misses.
source_quote: attempts to strike the creature attached to him with a hand axe but misses
subject: hand axe

fact: The party decides to prioritize the tomb over the Neverlight Grove, hoping to find treasure to aid against demonic threats.
source_quote: The party decides to prioritize the tomb, hoping to find magical treasure to aid them against demonic threats.
subject: route decision

fact: Jimjar wagers that the Myconid circle of joy will reveal itself to be a circle of unwilling vows.
source_quote: betting an empty shell gem that the Neverlight Grove's "circle of joy" would reveal itself to be a circle of "unwilling vows"
subject: Jimjar's wager

fact: Gyrgum accepts Jimjar's wager.
source_quote: Gyrgum took the bet.
subject: Gyrgum accepts bet

fact: Gyrgum accepts the bet regarding the Myconid circle.
source_quote: Gyrgum takes the bet.
subject: Gyrgum's bet accepted

fact: Zalthir shrouds the boat in darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir offers to shroud the boat in darkness. The DM rules the spell lasts up to 10 minutes.
subject: Zalthir's shroud spell

fact: Thorin rolls with disadvantage in chain mail and gets a 15 on stealth.
source_quote: Thorin rolls with disadvantage in chain mail and gets 15.
subject: Thorin's stealth check

fact: Daz rolls with advantage but slips and makes noise during stealth checks.
source_quote: Daz rolls with advantage for his drow paranoia but slips and makes noise.
subject: Daz's stealth check

fact: Daz considers a crowd-control spell that would catch the party but holds off.
source_quote: He considers a crowd-control spell (30-foot cube, Wisdom 15 save) that would have caught the party too, but holds off.
subject: Daz's aborted spell

fact: Daz is a drow.
source_quote: Daz rolls with advantage for his drow paranoia
subject: Daz

fact: Jimjar makes a wager regarding the Myconid circle.
source_quote: Jimjar made a new wager, betting an empty shell gem
subject: Jimjar

fact: Zalthir proposes a compromise to raid the tomb before dealing with the Myconid circle.
source_quote: Zalthir proposed a compromise: raid the tomb first for a demon-slaying treasure, then deal with the troubled Myconid circle.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Thorin wears chain mail.
source_quote: Thorin rolls with disadvantage in chain mail and gets 15.
subject: Thorin
